title: Fix: 'SHOULD be reported as such' is not operationalizable (line 165)
description: Line 165: 'a persistent mismatch indicates a server implementation defect and SHOULD be reported as such' — reported to whom? How? Normative language with no mechanism. Either remove it or replace with concrete guidance: 'clients SHOULD log the discrepancy and SHOULD NOT silently retry indefinitely.'
close_reason: Replaced 'SHOULD be reported as such' with 'Clients SHOULD log the discrepancy and SHOULD NOT silently retry indefinitely.'
